PRES.name: Presence
PRES.governs: Will saves, awareness, persuasion, divine power

Human.abilityDesc: Once per Long Rest, when you use an ability requiring Resource Points, reduce the cost by 4 RP.

Dwarf.abilityDesc: Once per Short Rest, when you are forced to make a Fortitude Save, automatically succeed.

Elf.abilityDesc: Once per Short Rest, when you begin your turn adjacent to any cover, gain Advantage on your next Attack Roll or Stealth Check.

Gargan.abilityDesc: Once per Short Rest, when you hit a target with a melee attack (not Glancing Blow), that target suffers Disadvantage on its next attack against an ally other than you.

Kith.abilityDesc: Once per Short Rest, when you roll a 2 or 3 on any 2d10 check, immediately reroll and use the new result.

Goblinoid.abilityDesc: Once per Short Rest, when you attack a target suffering any condition, automatically convert a Glancing Blow to a Full Hit.

Fractal-Kin.abilityDesc: Once per Long Rest, when you use an ability requiring Resource Points, roll with Advantage or impose Disadvantage on your target.

The Echo.abilityDesc: When an enemy would hit you with a Glancing Blow, use your Reaction to move up to 10 ft without provoking Opportunity Attacks and ignore the damage entirely.

The Oakhaven.abilityDesc: When you have the Bloodied Condition (≤50% HP), become Resistant to one damage type of your choice.

Makari.abilityDesc: Once per Short Rest, when an ally within 30 ft fails a Will Save or Fortitude Save, use your Reaction to allow them to immediately reroll. They must use the new result.

Black Market Agent.featureDesc: Always find safe havens, fences, or debt collectors willing to exchange services even in heavily guarded cities.

Combat Veteran.featureDesc: You and one adjacent ally gain Advantage on Initiative Rolls in battles you prepare for and lead.

Disgraced Knight.featureDesc: Advantage on Persuasion checks impersonating a low-ranking officer. Identify military weaknesses in fortifications and patrols.

Lorekeeper.featureDesc: Spend 10 min in a library to locate any document or record. Once per Long Rest, make a Lore check with Advantage to recall info about a magical entity or historical figure.

Manhunter.featureDesc: Always locate bounty postings, contacts, or employers willing to pay for tracking or capture services.

Nobility.featureDesc: Access to high society and royal courts. Secure audiences with rulers, request favors, and are rarely detained by guards.

Temple Acolyte.featureDesc: Always find free food, lodging, and basic medical treatment from allied temples. Advantage on Treat Injury checks to stabilize dying allies.

Urchin.featureDesc: Advantage on checks to blend into a crowd or move through restricted areas without drawing attention.

Apothecary's Apprentice.featureDesc: Identify any poison, potion, or compound by scent or residue. Advantage on saves to resist inhaled toxins and mundane diseases.

Cult Survivor.featureDesc: Recognize signs and coded language of underground zealots. Advantage on Will saves against fear and demoralization effects.

Pit Fighter.featureDesc: Provoke massive distractions or start riots in populated areas. Criminal enforcers generally respect your strength and will parley first.

Frontier Pioneer.featureDesc: Predict severe weather 24 hours in advance. No penalties to Awareness checks while asleep; instantly wake to approaching threats.

Monster Harvester.featureDesc: Extract venom, glands, and magical organs without ruining the yield. Advantage on Awareness checks to detect monstrous or extraplanar creatures.

Sapper / Combat Engineer.featureDesc: Automatically spot non-magical traps and structural weak points. Rig perimeter alarms, snares, or barricades in 10 minutes.

Heretic Scholar.featureDesc: Know inner workings of banned religions and ancient entities. Secure safe passage from hostile zealots using hidden litanies.

Plague Warden.featureDesc: Bypass city quarantines, requisition medical supplies from garrisons, and handle biological or magical hazards safely.

Mobility.desc: Climbing, swimming, jumping, feats of strength, evasive maneuvers, escaping grapples.

Subterfuge.desc: Moving silently, hiding, picking locks, sleight of hand, disarming traps.

Lore.desc: Magic theory, identifying spells/artifacts, ancient history, planar lore.

Investigation.desc: Analyzing clues, researching, assessing enemy formations, planning battlefield strategy.

Crafting.desc: All physical creation and modification: weapons, armor, mechanical objects.

Alchemy.desc: Mixing compounds, identifying toxins, creating poisons, brewing elixirs.

Awareness.desc: Spotting hidden enemies, detecting hazards, reading emotional states, sensing lies.

Survival.desc: Tracking, foraging, wilderness navigation, predicting weather.

Treat Injury.desc: Healing wounds, diagnosing illness, stabilizing downed allies.

Faith.desc: Sacred texts, divine/primal signs, deity tenets, religious rituals.

Persuasion.desc: Influencing NPCs, diplomacy, deception, threatening foes, inspiring fear or loyalty.

features: Unbreakable Focus: Once per Long Rest, Action to recover half FP
Martial Prowess: Extra Attack (2 attacks per Action)
Passive damage bonus: +1d6 once per turn
Passive damage bonus increases to +2d6 once per turn
Warrior's Edge: Critical Hit threshold reduced by 1 (17+)
Strand Sense: Passively sense active magic within 30 ft.
Arcane Discipline: Advanced Augments Unlocked (Level 3+ gated augments)
Mastered Discipline: Expert Augments Unlocked (Level 5+ gated)
Strand Focus: Mastered Ward — +2 Defense Score
Strand Focus: +2 to all Will Saves
Weaver of the Mind: First Spell Form each combat costs 6 AP less
Divine Insight: Spirit Level 3+ Inscriptions Unlocked
Embodied Faith: When casting Restorative or Ward of Faith, recipient gains +2 DEF until your next turn
Channel Divinity: Once per Short Rest, Bonus Action to recover 6 SP

passives: Iron Discipline (Passive): +2 DEF when wearing Heavy Armor with Shield. Learn 2 additional Tactical Maneuvers at Level 1.
Heavy Armor & Shield proficiency.

abilities.name: Challenge
abilities.desc: Select one enemy within 30 ft. Their next attack against a target other than you is made at Disadvantage.

abilities.name: Guardian's Intercept
abilities.desc: When an enemy makes a melee attack against an ally within 15 ft., become the target instead.

abilities.name: Defensive Formation
abilities.desc: Until end of next turn, you and allies within 10 ft. gain Resistance to all Physical Damage.

4.name: Guardian Stance
4.desc: Advantage on Fort Saves vs Prone/Pushed. Once per Short Rest, Reaction to reduce damage to you or adjacent ally by half.

7.name: Counter-Pressure
7.desc: Challenge now targets up to 3 enemies. Reaction + 3 FP: when enemy within 10 ft. disengages from you, immediately attack them.

10.name: Immovable Object (Capstone)
10.desc: Immunity to Prone and Grappled. Iron Discipline now grants you and allies within 15 ft. +4 Defense Score. Seismic Shock becomes Earthquake (doubled radius, 2d6+FORT damage, 8 FP).

passives: Battle-Hardened: +3 Max HP per level. No armor/shield proficiencies but can wield light weapon in offhand.
Level 5: Deal +1d6 damage once per turn when you deal damage (increases to +2d6 at Level 8).

abilities.name: Crushing Blow
abilities.desc: Single melee attack + 1d8 bonus damage. Target makes Fort Save or becomes Prone (Disadvantage on save if hit is Standard or Critical).

abilities.name: Relentless Pursuit
abilities.desc: Move up to half speed toward a visible enemy. If ending within 5 ft., first attack this turn deals +1d8 bonus damage.

abilities.name: Enrage
abilities.desc: Enter Rage until end of combat or unconscious. Rage: +half FORT mod damage, Advantage on Fort Saves. Bloodied Fury: Resistance to Physical Damage while Raging and Bloodied. Suspended by Staggered/Distracted.

abilities.name: Fury's Defiance
abilities.desc: When hit by a melee attack, immediately make one melee attack against the attacker.

abilities.name: Sacrificial Fury
abilities.desc: Take 3d6 irresistible damage, then make a melee attack dealing double that damage. Converts Glancing Blow to Full Damage.

4.name: Brutal Momentum
4.desc: After Relentless Pursuit, one enemy you hit has Disadvantage on their next Fort Save before your next turn.

7.name: Tireless Fury
7.desc: Rage no longer suspends from Staggered/Distracted. Once per turn while Raging, auto-succeed a Fort Save and recover 2 FP.

10.name: Apex Predator (Capstone)
10.desc: Once per turn while Raging, hitting with melee regains 1d8 HP. Sacrificial Fury now deals 5d6 damage (half to you, doubles to target).

passives: Beast Bond: Gain an Animal Companion. HP = Nomad's total HP. Uses your DEF and saves. Dismissed if you hit 0 HP.
Pack Maneuvers: Companion moves up to 30 ft. Attacks can originate from companion's space.
Hunter's Stance: +1d6 damage on ranged attack if not moved this turn. +2d6 if forgoing both move and action (Long Shot Setup).
Beast's Instinct: +1 bonus to Awareness and Survival.
Light Armor proficiency.
Level 5: Deal +1d6 damage once per turn (increases to +2d6 at Level 8).

abilities.name: Tactical Assist
abilities.desc: Command companion to harry an enemy within 5 ft. Target makes REF Save vs Scaling Threat DC or suffers Distracted until your next turn.

abilities.name: Focus Shot
abilities.desc: Single ranged attack. On hit, target makes REF Save or is Staggered until start of its next turn.

abilities.name: Mark Quarry
abilities.desc: Select enemy within 60 ft. Enemy is Marked until defeated or combat ends. All Maneuvers used against Marked enemy cost 1 FP less.

abilities.name: Evasive Shift
abilities.desc: When attacked, +2 DEF against that attack. If result is Glancing Blow, immediately move 15 ft. without provoking OAs. Applies to you or companion.

abilities.name: One Perfect Shot
abilities.desc: After Long Shot Setup, ranged attack with Advantage. Natural 12+ counts as Critical Hit. Cannot attack the following round.

4.name: Shared Instinct
4.desc: Mark Quarry grants you and up to 2 allies within 30 ft. +1 to Attack Rolls against the Marked enemy.

7.name: Master Tracker
7.desc: Advantage on Awareness and Survival checks (+2 to both). Mark Quarry now free (no FP cost). Defeating a Marked enemy lets you use Mark Quarry as Free Action on new target.

10.name: Untouchable Hunter (Capstone)
10.desc: Focus Shot: enemy failing Staggered save gives you 2 FP back. One Perfect Shot can now make a Bonus Action Attack while Long Shot Setup is active.

passives: Exploit Vulnerability: +1d6 damage when hitting a conditioned target or target that doesn't see you. Scales: 2d6 at L3, 3d6 at L5, 4d6 at L7, 5d6 at L9. Once per round.
Light Armor proficiency. Can wield Light Weapons.
Level 5: Deal +1d6 damage once per turn (increases to +2d6 at Level 8).

abilities.name: Feinting Strike
abilities.desc: Contested Subterfuge vs target's Awareness. If successful, next attack against them within 1 minute is an automatic critical. Once per encounter.

abilities.name: Hidden Movement
abilities.desc: Take the Dodge, Disengage, or Hide action provided you have cover or sufficient obscurement.

abilities.name: Uncanny Dodge
abilities.desc: When hit by an attack, halve the damage taken. Declared after damage is rolled.

abilities.name: Master Assassin
abilities.desc: Mark one enemy within 60 ft. For the next two turns, damage ignores their DEF and Exploit Vulnerability deals maximum possible damage.

4.name: Evasion
4.desc: On effects requiring REF Save for half damage: take no damage on success, half on failure.

7.name: Precise Targeting
7.desc: Hidden Movement no longer costs FP. When attacking an enemy within 5 ft. of an ally, recover 1 FP.

10.name: Deathblow Specialist (Capstone)
10.desc: Once per Long Rest, immediately declare next attack against a new enemy this turn as a Critical Hit with maximum Exploit Vulnerability damage.

passives: Arcane Cartography: On Long Rest, gain temporary AP = double your Mind level (reset on Long Rest). Start with 3 Augments at Level 1 instead of 2. Learn 2 Augments per level-up instead of 1.
Strand Sense: Passively sense active magic, traps, effects, and enchanted objects within 30 ft.
No Armor or Shield proficiencies.

abilities.name: Contingency Spell
abilities.desc: Slot one Spell Form with Augments (max cost: Mind Level + 4 AP) into a Contingency Slot. Cast later as a Reaction at normal cost. Hold one at a time.

abilities.name: Warding Formula
abilities.desc: When a target within 60 ft. casts a spell, they make a Will Save vs Spell Save DC. Failure: Disadvantage on attack roll or Advantage for saves against their spell. On enemy failure, recover 2 AP.

abilities.name: Paradox Engine
abilities.desc: Until end of next turn, all Strand Augment AP costs reduced by 4 (min 0). Applies once per spell cast.

4.name: Enhanced Contingency
4.desc: Hold two Contingency Slots (max Mind Level + 5 AP each). Use Reaction to cast either.

7.name: Counterspell
7.desc: Reaction: when enemy within 60 ft. casts a spell, immediately cast any Action Spell Form (pay normal AP). Warding Formula now costs 0 AP and still rewards 2 AP.

10.name: Master Paradox
10.desc: Paradox Engine lasts five turns. First attack roll or save during that time is made with Advantage (or Disadvantage for enemy save).

passives: Wild Augmentation: Access to Wild Augments pool. On level-up, choose standard Strand Augment OR Wild Augment.
Poisoned counts as a Basic (Low) Condition for Imposing Conditions.
Light Armor proficiency.

abilities.name: Aspect Shift
abilities.desc: Enter Beast Aspect until end of combat (or unconscious). Melee attacks use INT or PRES mod, deal 2d6 damage. Choose one aspect: Predator (+20 ft speed, ignore difficult terrain), Sentinel (+2 DEF), Bloom (Restorative and Grant Buff Augments cost 1 AP less). Outside combat: functionally transform into a low-threat beast.

abilities.name: Earthbound Thorns
abilities.desc: Manifest a tangled barrier within 60 ft (20 ft wall or 15 ft radius). Enemies entering take 2d6 Piercing automatically. Fort Save vs Scaling Threat DC or become Slowed. Persists until encounter ends.

abilities.name: Nature's Rebuke
abilities.desc: When you take damage from an enemy within 30 ft., that enemy makes a Fort Save vs Scaling Threat DC or is subject to an Advanced condition of your choice.

4.name: Symbiotic Flow
4.desc: Select a Symbiotic Focus (Predator, Sentinel, or Bloom) that remains active even outside Aspect Shift. While in Aspect Shift, that benefit is doubled: Predator +40 ft, Sentinel +4 DEF, Bloom -2 AP on Restorative Augments.

7.name: Overgrowth
7.desc: When you successfully apply an Impose Condition Augment, a 10 ft radius around that enemy becomes Difficult Terrain until end of combat.

10.name: Primal Avatar
10.desc: When using Aspect Shift, immediately cast Rooting Tendrils (Wild Augment) at no cost hitting all enemies within 15 ft. Nature's Rebuke is now once per Short Rest. Aspect Shift costs 0 AP.

passives: Symbiotic Bond: Gain a permanent Anima companion. Always aware of Anima's emotional state and well-being.
Shared Senses: Action to see/hear through Anima for 1 minute (within 1 mile).
Limited Restoration: Can only target Anima with Restorative or Defensive Augment Spell Forms.
Spells can originate from Animist or Anima.
Start with 1 Anima Form. Gain additional forms at Level 3, 6, and 9.
No Armor or Shield proficiencies.

abilities.name: Quick Command
abilities.desc: Command Anima to move up to 15 ft. or take the Disengage action.

abilities.name: Anima Manifestation
abilities.desc: Activate one Anima Augment you have learned.

abilities.name: Summoning Ritual
abilities.desc: Once per encounter, summon/return Anima with ½ HP.

abilities.name: Perfect Synergy
abilities.desc: You make a Channel Cantrip attack while Anima makes a standard attack. Double all damage dice. Any roll below 13 counts as 13. Target makes Fort Save vs Scaling Threat DC or is Stunned until end of your next turn.

4.name: Spirit Renewal
4.desc: Action: Instantly restore Anima to ½ max HP and remove all Basic conditions from it. Once per Long Rest.

7.name: Masterful Coordination
7.desc: Quick Command costs 0 AP. When you cast a damaging Strand Augment targeting an enemy within 30 ft of Anima, Anima may make a single Attack Roll against that target as a Free Action.

10.name: Ascendant Anima
10.desc: Change Anima's Form as Bonus Action at no cost. On form change, may immediately use Perfect Synergy as Reaction if available.

Shadow-Stalker.passive: Attacks vs targets engaged with allies have Advantage. +10 ft speed.
Shadow-Stalker.special: Pounce (Action): Athletics check to impose Grappled on target within 5 ft.

Obsidian Shell.passive: Anima +1 DEF. Allies within 10 ft gain +2 DEF for 1 round after leaving area.
Obsidian Shell.special: Energy Block (Action): Resistance to all Ranged Damage to allies within 10 ft until your next turn.

Whispering Wyld.passive: Not affected by OAs. Allies ending turn within 10 ft gain Advantage on next Will or Reflex Save.
Whispering Wyld.special: Area Shift (Bonus Action): Teleport up to 30 ft. Ends Basic conditions on allies within 10 ft.

Stone Weaver.passive: Cannot be pushed/pulled/moved. Glancing Blow melee attacks cause Slowed.
Stone Weaver.special: Shifting Earth (1/combat Action): Enemies within 15 ft make REF Save or fall Prone. Area becomes Difficult Terrain.

Spark Siren.passive: When Siren takes damage, attacker makes REF Save or suffers Distracted until their next turn.
Spark Siren.special: Static Veil (Bonus Action): Animist's next spell ignores 3 DEF, or next attack roll has Advantage.

passives: Unwavering Devotion: When casting Restorative or Grant Buff Augment, regain 1 SP. Once per Short Rest, cast a Restorative Augment costing 3 SP or less for 0 SP.
Heavy Armor proficiency.

abilities.name: Purifying Light
abilities.desc: Select and execute one Divine Inscription costing 3 SP or less (Restorative/Buff only). After executing, make one melee attack against an adjacent enemy.

abilities.name: Beacon of Hope
abilities.desc: Designate one ally within 60 ft. They gain +1 DEF and all healing they receive from you is maximum (not rolled) until your next turn.

abilities.name: Divine Intervention
abilities.desc: When an ally within 60 ft. fails a Saving Throw, grant them Advantage on that save, potentially turning it to a success.

abilities.name: Miracle of Life
abilities.desc: Choose up to 3 allies within 30 ft. and heal each by ½ their maximum HP.

4.name: Aura of Sanctuary
4.desc: When you cast a Restorative or Ward effect, you and allies within 10 ft. gain +2 to Will Saves until your next turn.

7.name: Master Healer
7.desc: Max die on Restorative Augment healing increases by 2 (d8 → d10). Beacon of Hope no longer costs SP.

10.name: Celestial Conduit (Capstone)
10.desc: Unwavering Devotion now refunds 2 SP. Miracle of Life now also removes all Conditions from affected allies.

passives: Sacred Aegis: Heavy Armor and Shield proficiency. Pool = 5 × level, recovers on Long Rest. Action: spend points to heal a target or cleanse a Condition (GM discretion). On Critical Hit, recover 2d6 SP.

abilities.name: Divine Strike
abilities.desc: For every 3 SP spent, deal +2d6 Radiant bonus damage on a weapon attack. Maximum 9 SP per attack.

abilities.name: Bolster Stance
abilities.desc: One ally within 30 ft (and you) gain Advantage on next Fort or Will Save, OR that ally gains Advantage on their next attack.

abilities.name: Shield of Faith
abilities.desc: When an ally within 10 ft. is hit by an attack, grant them Resistance to that attack's damage. Declared after damage roll.

abilities.name: Oath of Vengeance
abilities.desc: Choose a target. For the next 3 turns, melee weapon attacks deal +1d8 Radiant and all attacks are made with Advantage against that target.

4.name: Unbreakable Aura
4.desc: Aura Augment radius increases to 15 ft. Bolster Stance SP cost permanently reduced to 1 SP.

7.name: Sustained Smite
7.desc: Divine Strike maximum SP increases to 12 SP. Gain Advantage on Will and Fortitude Saves.

10.name: Holy Presence (Capstone)
10.desc: Immunity to Frightened. Oath of Vengeance now causes enemies within 15 ft to make Will Save or suffer Frightened. Lasts 5 turns instead of 3.

passives: Covenant Surge: When you roll maximum on a damage die, roll another die of that value and add damage. SP total +4 at Level 1, +1 every level.
Shield proficiency. No armor proficiencies.

abilities.name: Chaotic Blast
abilities.desc: Close Burst (15 ft radius from you or Mark of the Pact target). Deals 3d6 Energy Damage.

abilities.name: Mark of the Pact
abilities.desc: Brand one enemy within 60 ft. All damage dice rolled against this target that show '1' may be rerolled once (by any source).

abilities.name: Sacrificial Ward
abilities.desc: Impose Disadvantage on an attack targeting you. All damage from that attack is also dealt to the attacker.

abilities.name: Absolute Fulfillment
abilities.desc: For the next 3 turns, Advantage on all Attack Rolls and targets have Disadvantage on saves vs your Inscriptions. Afterward, Will Save DC 10 + (2 × prior uses). Failure: roll 1d6 on Divine Reckoning Table.

4.name: Unstable Power
4.desc: Spend +2 SP on Chaotic Blast to increase radius to 20 ft and apply a Basic Condition to one additional enemy. You must make Fort Save (DC 13) or take 1d4 irresistible damage.

7.name: Binding Will
7.desc: Mark of the Pact no longer costs SP. Marked enemies attempting to move out of your line of sight must make Will Save vs Scaling Threat DC or lose their entire Move Phase.

10.name: Ascension of the Pact (Capstone)
10.desc: Permanent +2 Scaling Threat DC. Covenant Surge chain damage can now trigger twice per die. Absolute Fulfillment lasts 5 turns.

Aggressive.name: Aggressive Stance
Aggressive.desc: Your weapon attacks deal bonus damage equal to half your FORT modifier (rounded up). Your DEF is reduced by 2 (minimum 0). At Level 6, deal bonus damage equal to your full FORT modifier instead.

Iron.name: Iron Stance
Iron.desc: Gain +1 DEF. Movement speed reduced by 5 ft. Once per combat, when an enemy attempts to forcibly move you or knock you Prone, that attempt automatically fails.

Skirmisher.name: Skirmisher Stance
Skirmisher.desc: Movement speed increases by 10 ft. Opportunity Attacks against you are made at Disadvantage.

Commander.name: Commander's Stance
Commander.desc: Allies within 30 ft. gain +1 to their next attack roll each turn. Once per round, when an ally within 30 ft. lands a Full Hit, you may move 5 ft. as a Free Action (no OAs).

Duelist.name: Duelist's Stance
Duelist.desc: Designate one visible enemy as your Dueling Target. +1d6 bonus damage against them; Advantage on Saving Throws they force on you. Disadvantage on attacks against all other enemies. Target changes only if removed from combat.

Executioner.name: Executioner's Stance
Executioner.desc: Critical Hit threshold reduced by 1 (natural 17+). When you reduce a creature to 0 HP, recover 2 FP. All attacks against you have Advantage while this stance is active.

Marksman.name: Marksman's Stance
Marksman.desc: While you have not moved this turn, ranged attacks ignore 3 points of target's DEF. Ranged attacks beyond 30 ft. deal +1d6 bonus damage. Melee attacks against you have Advantage.

standard.name: Goading Strike
standard.desc: When you hit an enemy, they make a Will Save. On failure, Disadvantage on attacks against any target other than you until your next turn.

standard.name: Feint
standard.desc: The next ally to attack the same target before your next turn makes that attack with Advantage.

standard.name: Hunter's Pace
standard.desc: Grant yourself and one adjacent ally +10 ft movement speed until end of your next turn.

standard.name: Reckless Rush
standard.desc: Move up to full speed and ignore Difficult Terrain. The next attack against you has Advantage.

standard.name: Iron Will
standard.desc: As a Reaction to being targeted by a Will Save, gain Advantage on the save.

standard.name: Guarding Stance
standard.desc: Gain Resistance to all Physical Damage from the next attack or until your next turn.

standard.name: Intercept
standard.desc: When an adjacent ally is targeted by melee or ranged attack, step in and become the target. If result is Glancing Blow, take no damage.

standard.name: Rally
standard.desc: Inspire an ally within 30 ft. They recover 1d8 HP and gain Advantage on their next Saving Throw.

standard.name: Conditioning
standard.desc: Bonus Action: recover +2 FP. As an Action: gain 6 FP. These amounts double at Level 5.

standard.name: Disarming Strike
standard.desc: On hit, target makes Fort Save or drops one weapon/item they're holding in an adjacent space.

standard.name: Precision Strike
standard.desc: Convert a Glancing Blow to Full Damage on this attack.

standard.name: Disrupting Strike
standard.desc: On hit, target makes Fort Save or suffers Distracted (Advanced) until start of their next turn.

standard.name: Momentum
standard.desc: When you reduce an enemy to 0 HP, immediately move up to full speed (no OAs) and make one standard melee attack.

standard.name: Bait & Switch
standard.desc: You and one ally within 5 ft. swap places. Both may immediately move 10 ft. in any direction without provoking OAs.

standard.name: Riposte
standard.desc: When an enemy hits you with a Glancing Blow, immediately make a counter-attack against them with Advantage.

standard.name: Exploit Retreat
standard.desc: When an enemy Disengages near you, make one Attack Roll. Full Hit: target is Staggered. Glancing Blow: speed -10 ft this round.

advanced.name: Called Shot
advanced.desc: Declare a body part before attacking. Full Hit: Head → Dazed; Arm → Disarmed; Leg → Slowed; Torso → Staggered.

advanced.name: The Sundering Execution
advanced.desc: Melee attack. Full Damage: double weapon base dice and target Fort Save. Failure: shatter armor (DEF -2), destroy weapon, or maim limb (Weakened + Dazed until healed). Lethal Momentum: non-Boss enemy below 25% HP is instantly executed.

advanced.name: Shatter Guard
advanced.desc: When an enemy uses a defensive ability (Guarding Stance, Bark Skin, Ancestral Ward, or Resistance/bonus DEF), Reaction to attack them. Full Hit: ignore their defensive effect entirely.

advanced.name: Juggernaut's Breach
advanced.desc: Move in a straight line up to full speed through enemy spaces. Each enemy passed through takes half FORT score Bludgeoning and makes REF Save or is knocked aside and Prone. Make one standard melee attack at final position.

advanced.name: The Anvil (Defy Death)
advanced.desc: When damage would reduce you to 0 HP, drop to 1 HP. Clear all Basic conditions. Immediately take one free Attack action or Rally maneuver out of turn.

advanced.name: Strand-Sever (Mage-Breaker)
advanced.desc: When enemy within your movement speed begins casting a spell, dash to adjacent space and make melee attack. Full Hit: enemy makes Fort Save or suffers Dazed and Distracted.

Vanguard.name: Sunder Defense
Vanguard.desc: Melee attack + apply 1 stack of Sunder. Stack 1: target -1 DEF. Stack 2: -2 DEF. Stack 3: -3 DEF, all party attacks vs target have Advantage (or choose to strip physical Resistance instead).

Vanguard.name: Seismic Shock
Vanguard.desc: Slam weapon/shield into earth. All enemies in 10 ft radius take FORT modifier Bludgeoning. Speed reduced to 0 until end of their next turn; suffer Distracted.

Vanguard.name: Indomitable Bastion
Vanguard.desc: Until start of your next turn, DEF is doubled and you are immune to being pushed, knocked prone, or moved against your will.

Scourge.name: Blood-Drunk Whirlwind
Scourge.desc: Melee attack against every enemy within your weapon's reach. Roll weapon damage dice once; apply total to all affected targets.

Scourge.name: Reckless Abandon
Scourge.desc: Your next attack this turn deals maximum possible damage automatically. Drawback: your DEF becomes 0 until start of your next turn.

Scourge.name: Gore-Spattered Roar
Scourge.desc: Melee attack. If it reduces target to 0 HP, recover HP equal to damage dealt. Enemies within 30 ft that witness this make Will Save or are Frightened (can't move closer) for 1 minute.

Nomad.name: Vaulting Shot (Disengage)
Nomad.desc: Make a single ranged attack, then instantly leap up to 15 ft directly away from your target, ignoring difficult terrain with no OA triggers.

Nomad.name: Splintering Volley
Nomad.desc: Fire a cluster into the air. All creatures in a 15 ft radius of target point take base weapon damage. Area becomes Difficult Terrain until cleared.

Nomad.name: Predator's Focus
Nomad.desc: Ranged attack that completely ignores target's DEF and Cover bonuses. If it kills the target, instantly regain 3 FP.

Marauder.name: Smoke Bomb
Marauder.desc: Trigger: take damage from physical attack. Effect: halve the incoming damage. Drop smoke bomb creating heavily obscured 10 ft radius.

Marauder.name: Arterial Sever
Marauder.desc: Make a melee attack. Target takes normal weapon damage and gains Bleed: 1d6 True Damage per turn until magical healing or Action to bandage.

Marauder.name: Coup de Grâce
Marauder.desc: Trigger: target must be Bleeding, Blinded, or in obscured area. Melee attack with Advantage. Full Hit: normal weapon damage + 3d8 True Damage. If target was Bleeding, bleed ends.

basic.name: Destructive
basic.desc: Adds damage: Spell deals 2d6 damage per affected enemy target. Must take this for spell to deal damage. +2 AP per additional 2d6.

basic.name: Restorative
basic.desc: Adds healing: Spell restores 2d8 HP to each affected ally. Spend another +3 AP to add 2d8 more healing.

basic.name: Impose Minor Condition
basic.desc: Imposes one Basic condition (Prone, Staggered, Grappled, Dazed, Frightened) on targets that fail the Save.

basic.name: Impose Major Condition
basic.desc: Imposes one Advanced condition (Blinded, Distracted, Restrained, Silenced, Weakened, Poisoned) on targets that fail the Save. Level 3+ required.

basic.name: Impose Severe Condition
basic.desc: Imposes one Expert condition (Stunned, Paralyzed) on targets that fail the Save. Level 5+ required.

damage.name: Elemental Shift
damage.desc: Deals 1d6 damage and changes all damage to Fire, Ice, Lightning, Acid, or Thunder.

damage.name: Flawless Strike
damage.desc: If this Spell Form lands a Glancing Blow, it is converted to Full Damage instead.

damage.name: Aftershock
damage.desc: If the target already has any condition applied, this Spell Form deals an additional 1d8 bonus damage.

damage.name: Kinetic Chain
damage.desc: If Spell Form deals damage, damage dealt is also dealt to a second enemy target within 10 ft. of the primary target. No additional roll.

damage.name: Life Siphon
damage.desc: If this Spell Form deals damage, recover HP equal to half the total damage dealt (rounded down).

damage.name: Astral Link
damage.desc: If Spell Form hits or affects a target with another within 30 ft, create a temporary link. Half damage to one linked enemy is also dealt to the other. Link breaks if targets move more than 30 ft apart.

control.name: Expose
control.desc: If Spell Form hits or affects a target, that target's DEF is reduced by 2 until start of your next turn. Does not stack.

control.name: Enervate
control.desc: If Spell Form deals damage, that target's damage rolls are reduced by 1d10 until start of your next turn.

control.name: Displacement
control.desc: If Spell Form affects a target, push or pull that target up to 15 ft. Target may Fort Save to resist.

control.name: Silence
control.desc: Targets that fail their Save suffer Silenced condition. Cannot cast Spell Forms, use verbal abilities, or maintain Focused Sustain.

control.name: Gravity Well
control.desc: Requires Burst or Wave Spell Form. Affected targets that fail Save are also pulled up to 10 ft toward the center after damage.

utility.name: Greater Reach
utility.desc: Doubles the Spell Form's range (e.g., 60 ft. becomes 120 ft.).

utility.name: Haste Field
utility.desc: If Spell Form affects an ally (including you), that ally's movement speed is doubled until end of their next turn.

utility.name: Flicker Warp
utility.desc: After casting this Spell Form, teleport up to 30 ft. to an unoccupied space you can see.

utility.name: Shockwave
utility.desc: After Spell Form resolves, all creatures within 10 ft. of you make REF Save or are pushed 10 ft. away and knocked Prone.

utility.name: Concussive Force
utility.desc: If Spell Form deals damage on a Full Hit, push the target up to 10 ft. No Save.

utility.name: Spellmark
utility.desc: If Spell Form hits or affects a target, that target is Marked. Your next Spell Form vs Marked target costs 1 AP less and deals +1d6 bonus damage.

defensive.name: Veil of Strands
defensive.desc: If Spell Form targets an ally (including you), that ally gains +5 DEF to the next single instance of damage they take.

defensive.name: Fortify
defensive.desc: If Spell Form targets an ally (including you), that ally gains temporary HP equal to 1d6 + INT or PRES modifier.

defensive.name: Warding Shell
defensive.desc: If Spell Form targets an ally (including you), that ally becomes Resistant to one specific damage type of your choice until your next turn.

defensive.name: Arcane Vanguard
defensive.desc: If Spell Form targets an ally (including you), that ally's next attack this round is treated as a Full Hit regardless of the roll.

defensive.name: Momentum Surge
defensive.desc: If Spell Form targets an ally (including you), that ally may immediately move up to their full speed as a Free Action (no OAs).

combination.name: Overload
combination.desc: If you have already cast a Spell Form this turn, this Spell Form's base cost is reduced to 0 AP. You still pay all Augment costs.

combination.name: Echo
combination.desc: Replays the last Spell Form you cast this combat — same Augments, different target/position. Pay only the Echo cost. Deals half damage/effect.

combination.name: Lingering Effect
combination.desc: If Spell Form imposes a condition via Impose Condition Augment, the condition persists for one additional round beyond its normal duration.

combination.name: Split Cast
combination.desc: Targets two separate creatures instead of one (Simple Projection and similar only). Each target affected independently — roll separately. Total AP cost applies once.

combination.name: Temporal Hitch
combination.desc: If Spell Form fails to affect a target (successful Save), delay the effect. It reapplies at the start of that target's next turn with Disadvantage on their Save.

combination.name: Strand Barrier
combination.desc: Creates a shimmering barrier around one ally within 60 ft (or yourself). Until your next turn, that ally cannot be affected by new conditions from attacks or spells.

wild.name: Thorn Whip
wild.desc: If Spell Form hits an enemy, pull that target up to 10 ft toward you or terrain feature (Fort Save resists). If pulled adjacent to active Earthbound Thorns, also Rooted until your next turn.

wild.name: Rooting Tendrils
wild.desc: Targets that fail their Save suffer the Rooted condition (Speed 0, can't be forcibly moved). May be cast at no cost during Primal Avatar Aspect Shift.

wild.name: Shifting Ground
wild.desc: If Spell Form hits or affects a target, target must REF Save or fall Prone. 10 ft radius around impact becomes Difficult Terrain until your next turn.

wild.name: Territorial Presence
wild.desc: If Spell Form hits or affects any target, all enemies within 15 ft. must succeed Will Save or be Frightened until end of your next turn.

wild.name: Savage Rend
wild.desc: While in Beast Aspect, if Spell Form deals damage on Full Hit, target bleeds for 1d6 damage per turn. Spend Action to stanch, or any healing ends the effect.

wild.name: Bark Skin
wild.desc: Target gains +2 DEF and Resistance to one instance of Physical Damage until your next turn. When targeting yourself with Self Channel, costs +2 AP instead.

wild.name: Regenerative Hide
wild.desc: Channel primal vitality through your transformed form, recovering 2d6 + PRES modifier HP.

wild.name: Spiritual Frenzy
wild.desc: If Spell Form deals damage, target is Staggered. Target must Will Save or be compelled to direct its next attack this round against you rather than any ally.

wild.name: Life Bloom
wild.desc: Each affected ally recovers an additional 1d4 HP and may immediately end one Basic condition currently affecting them.

wild.name: Elemental Symbiosis
wild.req: Beast Aspect active + Elemental Shift also applied
wild.desc: While in Beast Aspect, this Spell Form's damage ignores any enemy Resistance to its elemental damage type.

anima.name: Aggressive Tether
anima.desc: When Anima hits a Medium or smaller enemy, drag that target up to 10 ft into any unoccupied space. Target is Slowed until start of your next turn.

anima.name: Prowler's Strike
anima.desc: When Anima hits an enemy, target is Staggered until your next turn. All allies who hit that target before your next turn ignore 2 points of its DEF.

anima.name: Symbiotic Healing
anima.desc: Anima channels bond's healing energy. Both Anima and Animist immediately recover 2d8 + PRES modifier HP. Anima does not attack this turn.

anima.name: Anima Projection
anima.desc: Anima roots itself (Speed 0, no attack this turn) and projects a 10 ft spiritual aura. Allies within gain +2 DEF, can't be forcibly moved, and have Advantage on next Saving Throw.

anima.name: Spirit Swap
anima.desc: Reaction: When Animist is targeted by attack, Anima instantly swaps locations. Anima takes the hit, applying its own DEF.

anima.name: Ancestral Ward
anima.desc: Anima gains Resistance to all Physical Damage (Slashing, Piercing, Bludgeoning) until your next turn.

anima.name: Guardian Link
anima.desc: Reaction: When any ally other than Animist is targeted by an attack and Anima is within 30 ft., Anima moves to intercept and takes the hit. Spirit Swap and Guardian Link share your Reaction.

anima.name: Blinding Radiance
anima.desc: Anima releases burst of spiritual energy. All enemies within 15 ft. radius centered on Anima make REF Save or are Blinded until end of their next turn. Anima does not attack this turn.

anima.name: Primal Roar
anima.desc: Anima unleashes shockwave of primal force. All enemies within 15 ft. of Anima must REF Save or be pushed 10 ft. and Dazed. All allies in same radius cleared of Dazed and Distracted. Anima does not attack this turn.

universal.name: Prayer
universal.desc: As a Bonus Action in combat: gain 2 SP. As an Action: gain 6 SP. These amounts double at Level 5.

universal.name: Swift Blessing
universal.desc: One ally within 30 ft. gains +20 ft. movement speed and ignores non-magical Difficult Terrain until your next turn.

universal.name: Radiant Surge
universal.desc: One ally within 60 ft. gains 2d6 temporary HP, +10 ft. movement speed, and Advantage on their next attack roll — all until your next turn.

universal.name: Ward of Faith
universal.desc: Grants one ally within 30 ft. +2 Defense Score until start of your next turn.

universal.name: Aegis of Light
universal.desc: One ally within 30 ft. gains temporary HP equal to 1d8 + PRES modifier until your next turn or until depleted.

universal.name: Blessed Reflexes
universal.desc: One ally within 30 ft. gains +2 DEF and may reroll one Reflex Save before your next turn (use higher result).

universal.name: Purify Condition
universal.desc: Removes one Advanced condition from one ally within 30 ft. That ally also gains +1 DEF until your next turn.

universal.name: Restore Vitality
universal.desc: If Spell Form includes Restorative healing, target recovers an additional 2d6 HP and gains Resistance to Physical damage until your next turn.

universal.name: Righteous Mending
universal.desc: When you deal damage with a weapon attack or Spell Form, one ally within 30 ft. recovers 1d8 + PRES modifier HP.

universal.name: Smite
universal.desc: When you deal damage with a weapon attack or Spell Form, the attack deals an additional 1d12 Radiant damage.

universal.name: Mark of Valor
universal.desc: One ally within 30 ft. gains a sacred mark until your next turn. The first Full Hit they land deals +1d8 Radiant bonus damage.

universal.name: Hallowed Ground
universal.desc: Affects all creatures in the Spell Form's area. Enemies make Will Save or suffer Frightened. Allies in area gain +2 DEF until your next turn.

universal.name: Judgment
universal.desc: When you deal damage, all subsequent ally attacks against that target have Advantage until end of your next turn. Target also takes +1d6 damage from all sources until start of its next turn.

oracle.name: Empower Healing
oracle.desc: If Spell Form includes Restorative healing, target recovers +1d8 HP and one adjacent ally also recovers 1d4 HP.

oracle.name: Mass Renewal
oracle.desc: If Spell Form targets single ally with Restorative effect, it also affects two additional allies within 15 ft. Alternatively, remove one Basic or Advanced condition from the primary target.

oracle.name: Vision of Fate
oracle.desc: Until your next turn, one ally within 60 ft. makes their first attack roll or Saving Throw with Advantage. If it would be a Glancing Blow, it's treated as a Full Hit instead.

oracle.name: Shared Burden
oracle.desc: Until your next turn, when an ally within 60 ft. would take damage, absorb up to half (rounded down) yourself instead. Applies to up to two instances per turn.

oracle.name: Sanctuary
oracle.desc: One target within 30 ft. gains Immunity to all Advanced and Basic conditions until your next turn. That target also gains Advantage on their next Will Save.

templar.name: Aura of Protection
templar.desc: You and all allies within 10 ft. gain +2 Defense Score until start of your next turn.

templar.name: Consecrated Ground
templar.desc: Choose a 15 ft. radius within 60 ft. Until your next turn: enemies entering take 1d10 Radiant damage. Allies entering recover 1d6 HP once. Undead and Demon-type creatures are Frightened within the area.

templar.name: Aura of Courage
templar.desc: You and all allies within 10 ft. gain Advantage on all Saving Throws (Will, Reflex, Fortitude) until your next turn.

templar.name: Aura of Retribution
templar.desc: You and all allies within 15 ft. gain Advantage on their next Attack Roll. That attack deals +2d6 Radiant damage if it hits.

zealot.name: Chained Punishment
zealot.desc: When you deal damage with a weapon attack or Spell Form, immediately deal half that damage to one enemy within 10 ft. of the target. No attack roll required.

zealot.name: Covenant's Edge
zealot.desc: One ally within 30 ft. burns with covenant fire until your next turn. Their attacks deal +1d6 Radiant damage and their Critical Hit threshold is reduced by 1.

zealot.name: Wrathful Condemnation
zealot.desc: When you deal damage, target is Condemned until your next turn: cannot benefit from Resistance or Immunity. First ally to hit the Condemned target deals +1d8 Radiant bonus damage.

zealot.name: Agony
zealot.desc: When you deal damage, target is Distracted and takes +1d6 damage from all sources until your next turn.

zealot.name: Soul Brand
zealot.desc: When you deal damage, place a divine Brand on that target. While Branded: target takes +1d6 Radiant from every hit. If target reaches 0 HP while Branded, you recover 1d8 SP.

zealot.name: Fervent Absolution
zealot.desc: Remove one Basic condition from one ally within 30 ft. That ally also recovers 1d6 + PRES modifier HP.

zealot.name: Oblivion
zealot.desc: When you deal damage, target suffers Disadvantage on all Saving Throws and −2 DEF until end of your next turn.

spellForms.name: Channel Cantrip
spellForms.desc: Single target within 60 ft. Attack Roll. 1d6 damage. On Graze: recover 2 RP. Regular hit: recover 3 RP. Critical: recover 6 RP. At Level 4 and 8, fire an additional bolt (max 3).

spellForms.name: Simple Projection
spellForms.desc: Single target within 60 ft. Requires an Attack Roll.

spellForms.name: Close Burst
spellForms.desc: 15 ft. radius originating from you. Prompts a Saving Throw.

spellForms.name: Ranged Burst
spellForms.desc: 15 ft. radius at a point within 60 ft. Prompts a Saving Throw.

spellForms.name: Broad Wave
spellForms.desc: 30 ft. Cone or 60 ft. Line. Prompts a Saving Throw.

spellForms.name: Self Channel
spellForms.desc: Targets only you. No roll required.

spellForms.name: Arcane Wall
spellForms.desc: Creates a 30 ft. long, 15 ft. high barrier. No roll required.

spellForms.name: Binding Ring
spellForms.desc: 10 ft. radius ring around a central point within 60 ft. Prompts a Saving Throw.

spellForms.name: Sense Strands
spellForms.desc: Affects only you or one ally. Utility, usually no roll.

tiers.desc: Gain proficiency with one weapon type of your choice (Simple, Martial, or Exotic). Attacks with that weapon gain +1 to Attack Rolls.
Increase the damage die of your chosen weapon type by one tier (d6→d8, d8→d10, d10→d12). Additionally, on a Critical Hit with this weapon type, apply the weapon's special effect twice.
Off-hand attacks no longer cost RP. Draw both weapons simultaneously as a Free Action.
While wielding two weapons, gain +1 DEF. When you make your off-hand attack, apply your full ability modifier to the damage (not half).
Ranged attacks don't have Disadvantage from long range. Ignore half-cover on ranged attacks.
Before a ranged attack, declare a called shot: -2 to your attack roll for +2d6 bonus damage on a hit.
Gain Shield proficiency. When you use Guarding Stance maneuver, apply its resistance benefit to one adjacent ally as well.
Shield now adds +3 DEF instead of +2. Once per Short Rest, when targeted by a Close Burst or Broad Wave, use Reaction to negate the damage entirely.
Once per turn, when you make a melee weapon attack, reroll one of the weapon's damage dice and use the higher of the two results.
On a Critical Hit, all damage dice for that attack are maximized before rolling any bonus dice.
Opportunity Attacks deal full weapon damage (not half). When a creature triggers an OA from you, their Speed drops to 0 for that turn.
Gain an additional Reaction per round, usable only for Opportunity Attacks and the Intercept maneuver.
Gain the ability to cast a minor magical cantrip once per Long Rest — choose from: light, minor telekinesis (lift/move up to 5 lbs), or a minor sensory illusion (sight or sound, max 5 ft).

The cantrip can now be used 3 times per Long Rest. Additionally, if you are a non-caster, once per Long Rest you may spend RP to cast a Simple Projection + Destructive Augment (2d6 damage, 60 ft range) at a cost equal to 4 RP.
Once per Long Rest, when you witness an ill omen or foreboding event, you have an instinctive feeling whether it applies directly to you or the party (GM answers yes/no only).
You are immune to the Frightened condition. Once per Long Rest, Reaction: when you would take damage reducing you to 0 HP, instead drop to 1 HP.
Immune to RP Drain from Void entities. Void-type creatures within 30 ft. must make a Will Save (DC 14) or suffer Distracted for 1 round when they attempt to specifically target you.

Once per Long Rest: channel the Void. For 1 minute, your attacks deal +1d6 Necrotic damage and you can see through any magical darkness within 60 ft. However, allies within 10 ft. must succeed a Will Save (DC 12) or be briefly Distracted on their first turn during this time.

In your specialist area (a chosen trade: locks, traps, arcane devices, structural analysis, etc.), you always recognize relevant threats and identify non-magical traps automatically. You never need to roll to identify a relevant device you've encountered before.

Once per Long Rest, automatically identify and disarm one trap or arcane device without a roll. In combat, if you have tools available, spend one Action to temporarily disable a construct's special ability or an arcane field for 1 round.
Learn two additional languages of your choice. You can make rough sense of any written language (not perfect translation) with 10 minutes of study.
Learn two more languages. You can speak any language you've heard for more than a day (broken but functional). Written codes and ciphers yield their content to you with 30 minutes of work.
Unarmed strikes deal 1d6 damage. You can grapple as part of an attack action (no extra action cost).
Unarmed strikes deal 1d8. Your grapple attempts are made with Advantage. While grappling, your melee attacks deal +1d4 bonus damage.
After a 10-minute speech or briefing, grant up to 5 allies temporary HP equal to your level + PRES modifier. These expire at the next Short Rest.
Once per encounter as a Bonus Action: designate a Focus Target visible to the party. All allies gain +1d6 on their next Full Hit against it. You gain temporary HP equal to your PRES modifier.
Allies within 30 ft. who can see and hear you gain +1 to all Saving Throws.
Once per encounter, when an ally fails a Saving Throw, you may shout encouragement (no action cost). They may immediately reroll that save and use either result.
After 1 minute of conversation, you learn an NPC's primary motivation, their greatest current fear, and whether they are actively lying to you.

Once per encounter during a social interaction, declare a Commanding Word. One NPC that can hear you must make a Will Save (DC 14 + PRES mod) or comply with a simple, immediate instruction (sit down, drop a weapon, open a door). This is not mind control — it is authority.
In any city or settlement of moderate size or larger, you can locate a relevant contact (fence, informant, healer, smith) within 1 hour by asking the right people.

Once per Long Rest, call in a favor from your contact network. The GM determines what is feasible based on your relationships and location, but you can receive: a piece of actionable intelligence, passage through a restricted area, a safe house for the night, or delivery of a small non-magical item.
Advantage on Survival and Awareness checks in natural environments. Never become lost in natural terrain.
You and up to 5 companions leave no tracks in natural terrain (unless you choose to). You can track any creature that has passed within 48 hours on a DC 13 Survival check regardless of terrain.
You are immune to non-magical exhaustion effects. You require only 4 hours of rest for a Long Rest.
Immune to Slowed and Staggered conditions from physical exertion (e.g., forced marching, climbing, swimming). Additionally, once per Long Rest, recover ½ HP as a Free Action — a second wind.

weapons.name: Dagger
weapons.feature: Finesse, Quickdraw: Can be drawn or stowed as part of any attack. Can be thrown up to 20 ft.

weapons.name: Shortsword
weapons.feature: Finesse, Pursuit: After hitting the same target twice in one turn with any weapon, your next attack against them gains Advantage.

weapons.name: Hand Axe
weapons.feature: Thrown (20 ft.), Drag: If you deal damage to a target (melee or thrown), you may immediately move up to 10 ft. toward them without provoking an Opportunity Attack.

weapons.name: Rapier
weapons.feature: Finesse, Lunge: Strike targets up to 10 ft. away. When you use Lunge reach, the target cannot Opportunity Attack you when you step back within normal range that same turn.

weapons.name: Warhammer
weapons.feature: Shatter: Ignores up to 3 points of DEF. On a Full Hit against a target in Heavy Armor, the target loses their Reaction until the start of their next turn.

weapons.name: Battle Axe
weapons.feature: Cleave: Once per turn, make one additional melee attack against a different creature within 5 ft. as part of your first melee attack. The secondary target takes weapon damage dice only (no modifier).

weapons.name: Longsword
weapons.feature: Guard: On a Full Hit, roll 1d4 and increase your Defense Score by that amount until the start of your next turn. You can sacrifice this bonus to impose the same roll as a penalty to the attacker's next attack against you.

weapons.name: Maul
weapons.feature: Shatter: Ignores up to 3 DEF. Topple: Dealing 12+ damage forces a Fort Save or target falls Prone (Disadvantage if Staggered). Two-handed. Cannot be used in spaces narrower than 10 ft.

weapons.name: Greatsword
weapons.feature: Push: Full Hit allows you to move a target your size or smaller up to 10 ft. in a straight line. Sweep: If Push moves a target into another creature, both take 1d6 bludgeoning. Two-handed.

weapons.name: Halberd
weapons.feature: Reach: Can strike targets up to 10 ft. away. Halt: A Full Hit reduces the target's movement speed by 10 ft. until end of their next turn; 15 ft. if you did not move this turn. Two-handed.

weapons.name: Sling
weapons.feature: Harass: Glancing Blows deal normal damage. On a Full Hit, move up to 15 ft. without provoking an Opportunity Attack.

weapons.name: Shortbow
weapons.feature: Agile: Make one additional attack as a Bonus Action (costs 1 RP) if you have not moved more than 5 ft. this turn.

weapons.name: Light Crossbow
weapons.feature: Precise: Deals an additional 2d4 damage against targets suffering any Condition or with reduced Speed.

weapons.name: Longbow
weapons.feature: Halt: A Full Hit reduces the target's movement speed by 10 ft. Long Range Bonus: On a Full Hit against a target at 60 ft. or further, deal +1d6 bonus piercing damage.

weapons.name: Heavy Crossbow
weapons.feature: Armor Piercing: Ignores up to 3 DEF. Requires a Bonus Action or Action to reload after firing. Cannot be used as an off-hand weapon.

armor.name: Plate Armor
armor.stealth: Disadvantage on Subterfuge & Mobility checks. -5ft Speed

shields.name: Parrying Dagger
shields.feature: Deflect: Once per round, if hit by a melee attack, you may roll 1d4 and add it to your DEF for that single attack.

shields.name: Buckler
shields.feature: Free Hand: You can still hold (but not attack with) small items like potions or torches in your shield hand.

shields.name: Heater Shield
shields.feature: Bulwark: Requires an Action to don or doff.

shields.name: Tower Shield
shields.feature: Heavy: Requires an Action to don/doff. Bulky (2 Slots). You gain resistance to one ranged attack per round.

mundaneItems.name: Standard Rations (5 days)
mundaneItems.desc: Basic cured meats and hardtack. Spoils if submerged or left in severe heat.

mundaneItems.name: Pemmican (7 days)
mundaneItems.desc: High-density rations that will not freeze or spoil in extreme environments.

mundaneItems.name: Hoppy Ale
mundaneItems.desc: +1 to Persuasion and -1 to Awareness for the evening.

mundaneItems.name: Water Cask (10 days)
mundaneItems.desc: A sealed wooden cask. Holds enough water for 1 person for 10 days (or 5 days in deep desert).

mundaneItems.name: Standard Bedroll
mundaneItems.desc: Heavy wool blanket and ground tarp. Required to gain the benefits of a Long Rest in the wilderness.

mundaneItems.name: Expedition Tent (4-Person)
mundaneItems.desc: Canvas with alchemical waterproofing. Grants Advantage on camp checks in Severe weather or Tundra.

mundaneItems.name: Treated Firewood (Bundle)
mundaneItems.desc: Chemically treated wood that lights and burns hotly even in a blizzard or torrential downpour.

mundaneItems.name: Heavy Winter Furs
mundaneItems.desc: Equipped. Thick pelts protecting from cold exhaustion and Tundra hypothermia mechanics (+1 to rolls).

mundaneItems.name: Ice Cleats (Crampons)
mundaneItems.desc: Equipped. Metal spikes affixed to boots. Allows you to ignore movement penalties on solid ice.

mundaneItems.name: Snowshoes
mundaneItems.desc: Equipped. Disperses weight. Allows you to ignore movement penalties in deep snow.

mundaneItems.name: Sun-Cloak & Keffiyeh
mundaneItems.desc: Equipped. Breathable desert silks. Halves your required daily water intake in the Deep Desert.

mundaneItems.name: Sun-Goggles
mundaneItems.desc: Equipped. Prevents Snowblindness and Sun-Glare conditions (which inflict Distracted).

mundaneItems.name: Insectbane Salve (10 Uses)
mundaneItems.desc: Pungent wax. Prevents conditions caused by biting swamp swarms and malaria-analogues.

mundaneItems.name: Water-Breathing Bladder
mundaneItems.desc: An alchemical rebreather. Grants 10 minutes of breathable air underwater.

mundaneItems.name: Brass Spyglass
mundaneItems.desc: Magnifies vision 10x. Grants the Scout Advantage to spot POIs or ambushes in open terrain.

mundaneItems.name: Astrolabe & Star Charts
mundaneItems.desc: High-end instruments. Grants the Navigator Advantage on open ocean and deep desert course-setting.

mundaneItems.name: Collapsible 10ft Pole
mundaneItems.desc: Telescoping steel/wood. Trigger pressure plates or test sinkholes from a safe distance without spending RP.

mundaneItems.name: Signal Flare (Alchemical)
mundaneItems.desc: Shoots a brilliant light 200 feet into the air. Visible for up to 3 Hexes away.

mundaneItems.name: Luminescent Chalk (10 pc)
mundaneItems.desc: Crushed glow-cap mushrooms mixed with wax. Leaves marks that only glow in absolute darkness.

mundaneItems.name: Everburn Torch
mundaneItems.desc: A magic flame that never goes out; provides 5ft of radiant heat (can prevent freezing in an emergency).

mundaneItems.name: Torches (Bundle of 5)
mundaneItems.desc: Burns for 1 hour. Can be used as a makeshift weapon (deals 1 Fire damage on Full Hit).

mundaneItems.name: Hooded Oil Lantern
mundaneItems.desc: Projects light 30 ft. The hood can be closed as a Free Action (0 RP) to go dark instantly.

mundaneItems.name: Whale Oil (Flask)
mundaneItems.desc: High-grade fuel. Burns 50% longer than normal oil. If thrown (1 RP) and ignited, deals +1d6 Fire damage.

mundaneItems.name: Hemp Rope (50 ft.)
mundaneItems.desc: Standard, heavy rope. Supports up to 300 lbs safely.

mundaneItems.name: Climber's Kit (Polar)
mundaneItems.desc: Ice-specific harness, pitons, hammer, and frost-treated rope. Grants Advantage to scale ice walls/glaciers.

mundaneItems.name: Heavy Bear-Trap
mundaneItems.desc: Takes 1 RP to set. Triggers on entry: deals 1d8 damage and inflicts Restrained until pried off.

mundaneItems.name: Iron Spikes (12) & Mallet
mundaneItems.desc: Wedge doors shut (requires FORT check to break down) or anchor ropes.

mundaneItems.name: Grappling Hook
mundaneItems.desc: Allows rope to be secured to ledges or railings up to 30 feet away.

mundaneItems.name: Caltrops (Bag)
mundaneItems.desc: Covers a 5x5 ft area. Moving through at more than half speed deals 1 damage and halves remaining movement.

mundaneItems.name: Bag of Steel Bearings (1,000)
mundaneItems.desc: 1 RP to throw. Covers 10x10 ft. Creatures moving through at more than half speed make REF Save or fall Prone.

mundaneItems.name: Alchemist's Ash (Smoke Bomb)
mundaneItems.desc: 1 RP to throw. Creates 15 ft. radius sphere of thick smoke for 3 rounds. Blocks Line of Sight completely.

mundaneItems.name: Tangle-Resin Flask
mundaneItems.desc: 1 RP to throw. Target makes REF Save or is Rooted (Speed 0) until they or an ally spend an Action to remove it.

mundaneItems.name: Pouch of Fine Flour/Chalk
mundaneItems.desc: 1 RP to throw. Creates a 5 ft. cloud. Coats and reveals Invisible creatures, negating their advantages.

mundaneItems.name: Flash-Powder Packet
mundaneItems.desc: 1 RP to throw. 10 ft. burst. Enemies make Fort Save or become Dazed until end of their next turn.

mundaneItems.name: Flask of Caustic Acid
mundaneItems.desc: 1 RP to throw. Full Hit: 2d6 Acid damage and permanently reduces target DEF by 1. Glancing Blow: 1d6 only.

mundaneItems.name: Vial of Smelling Salts
mundaneItems.desc: 1 RP to use on adjacent ally. Instantly awakens from magical sleep or removes Distracted/Staggered.

mundaneItems.name: Throwing Knives (Set of 3)
mundaneItems.desc: 0 RP to draw. Ranged weapons (1d4 physical). Can throw one as part of standard Attack Action.

mundaneItems.name: Signal Whistle (Bone/Brass)
mundaneItems.desc: 0 RP to use. Emits a piercing shriek heard up to a mile away. Awakens sleeping allies instantly.

mundaneItems.name: Wrist-Grapple & Wire
mundaneItems.desc: 1 RP to fire. Spring-loaded dart with 20 ft. of wire. Allows instant vertical escapes or swinging movement.

mundaneItems.name: Thieves' Tools / Lockpicks
mundaneItems.desc: Required to attempt to pick locks or disarm mechanical traps. Illegal to possess in many jurisdictions.

mundaneItems.name: Arcanosmith's Tools
mundaneItems.desc: Calipers and focal lenses. Required to disarm magical traps or jury-rig arcane constructs.

mundaneItems.name: Heavy Crowbar
mundaneItems.desc: Grants Advantage on physical checks to force open jammed doors, chests, or grates.

mundaneItems.name: Steel Mirror (Handheld)
mundaneItems.desc: Used to safely look around corners or reflect light/gaze attacks.

mundaneItems.name: Leather Belt Pouch
mundaneItems.desc: Equipped. Holds up to twenty 0-Slot items (coins, gems, jewelry, rings, chalk) without occupying pack slots.

mundaneItems.name: Waterproof Satchel
mundaneItems.desc: A wax-sealed messenger bag. Anything inside (up to 3 Slots worth) is immune to water damage or spoiling.

mundaneItems.name: Tactical Bandolier
mundaneItems.desc: Equipped. Adds +1 Readied Slot specifically for potions, daggers, or scrolls for 0 RP mid-combat access.

mundaneItems.name: Large Sack (Empty)
mundaneItems.desc: Holds 3 Slots of loose loot. When full, carrying it occupies 1 of your hands.

mundaneItems.name: Standard Medkit (5 Uses)
mundaneItems.desc: Bandages and coagulants. Spend 1 RP to instantly stabilize a dying ally at 0 HP.

mundaneItems.name: Combat Stim-Poultice
mundaneItems.desc: Spend 1 RP to administer to an adjacent ally: heals 1d8 HP and instantly removes Dazed or Distracted.
